n5b9464a01c1.s: The first post-independence Law Commission of India (1955) was chaired by:
n5b9464a01c1.x: The first post-independence Law Commission was set up in 1955 under M.C. Setalvad; the colonial one under Macaulay had produced the IPC (1860).

n2127b3382f7.s: Which of the following Law Commission reports is wrongly matched with its subject?
o: 230th Report – 'Uncle judge' syndrome in High Courts
n2127b3382f7.x: The 59th Report (1974) was on family courts; Gram Nyayalayas was the subject of the 114th Report.

nd1684b4c47a.s: The Viksit Bharat Shiksha Adhishthan Bill, 2025 was referred to which body, which flagged centralisation?
o: A Select Committee of the Rajya Sabha
The National Commission for Higher Education and Research
nd1684b4c47a.x: The VBSA Bill was sent to a Joint Parliamentary Committee, which flagged centralisation; it was not passed in the Monsoon Session of 2026.

nf796dc2d973.s: The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 was defeated in the Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026 because it:
o: lacked ratification by half the States
was struck down by the Supreme Court
nf796dc2d973.x: The Bill was defeated in the Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026 because it did not secure the required two-thirds majority.

ncadc3bbb51a.s: The National Tribunals Commission proposed in the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 is to deal with:
o: Appointments, reviews and discipline of tribunals
Devolution of central taxes to States
ncadc3bbb51a.x: The proposed National Tribunals Commission (5 members, HQ New Delhi) is to handle appointments, reviews and discipline of tribunals.

nfbea443d2ad.s: After the 2019 amendment to the Protection of Human Rights Act, the NHRC Chairperson's term is:
nfbea443d2ad.x: Since the 2019 amendment, the NHRC chair (any Supreme Court judge, not only a former CJI) holds office for 3 years or up to age 70.

n43bfb16ed97.s: Which of the following survey – agency pairs is wrongly matched?
o: HCES 2022-23 and 2023-24 – Registrar General of India
n43bfb16ed97.x: HCES is conducted by NSO, MoSPI (it gives weights for the new CPI), not by the Registrar General of India.

n5343940092e.s: The Good Governance Index is published by:
n5343940092e.x: The Good Governance Index is published by DARPG; the SDG India Index and Composite Water Management Index are NITI Aayog's.

ca12a358beead2.s: What is the theme of India's 2026 BRICS Chairship?
o: Building Responsive, Inclusive and Collective Solutions
Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
ca12a358beead2.x: India's 2026 BRICS theme is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'; 2026 is India's fourth chairship, not fifth.

ca7bfeabec6c00.s: The New Development Bank agreement was signed at Fortaleza, Brazil, in:
ca7bfeabec6c00.x: The NDB agreement was signed at Fortaleza in 2014; 2010-11 was when South Africa was invited and joined.

cae5ddba43ee3d.s: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation was founded in 2001 in:
cae5ddba43ee3d.x: The SCO was founded in Shanghai in 2001 when Uzbekistan joined the Shanghai Five (China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan).

ca7413555e0566.s: India's National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission, launched in 2023, has a target year of:
ca7413555e0566.x: The National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission was launched in 2023 with a target of 2047.

ca14f40f1342e0.s: The US Executive Order of 29 September 2026 replaced the term 'AI' with 'Super Intelligence' in:
o: All US federal laws and contracts
Official non-legal documents of the US Federal Executive Branch
ca14f40f1342e0.x: It is only a US federal wording change for official non-legal documents; existing laws and contracts need not be amended.

ca269c5b4d3a1d.s: India rejected the Indus Waters Treaty ruling of which body, calling it an 'illegally constituted arbitral tribunal'?
ca269c5b4d3a1d.x: India rejected the Permanent Court of Arbitration ruling and did not take part; the PCA is distinct from the International Court of Justice.

caf02c0552e01d.s: BIMSTEC stands for Bay of Bengal Initiative for:
caf02c0552e01d.x: BIMSTEC is the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation.

ca90584702a252.s: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed on:
ca90584702a252.x: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed on 19 September 1960 at Karachi, brokered by the World Bank.

ca70e27d01a0cb.s: Under the Ramsar Convention, Ramsar sites with adverse ecological change are listed on the:
ca70e27d01a0cb.x: Sites with adverse ecological change go on the Montreux Record; designation and management of Ramsar Sites is one of the three pillars.

cn9d18d134ce4a.s: The IndiaAI Mission, approved on 7 March 2024, is implemented by:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
cn9d18d134ce4a.x: The IndiaAI Mission (Rs 10,371.92 crore over five years) is implemented by MeitY, not the Ministry of Science and Technology.

cn572202ac5548.s: The 14th International Tourism Mart at Tawang (October 2026) was organised by:
o: Union Ministry of Tourism with the Arunachal Pradesh government
cn572202ac5548.x: The 14th ITM was organised by the Union Ministry of Tourism with the Arunachal government; stakeholders came from 27 countries.

cnec9710c24721.s: The first edition of India Energy Week was held in 2023 in:
cnec9710c24721.x: India Energy Week began in Bengaluru (2023); its 4th edition was in Goa (2026).

cn947dde7aabf3.s: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (9 January) marks Mahatma Gandhi's return from South Africa in:
cn947dde7aabf3.x: PBD is observed on 9 January because Gandhi returned to India from South Africa on 9 January 1915.

cnf43270eb43d3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UN Convention against Transnational Organized Crime (UNTOC)?
o: It came into force on 29 September 2005
It was adopted by the UN General Assembly on 15 November 2000
It has a protocol on smuggling of migrants
It has protocols on trafficking in persons and firearms
cnf43270eb43d3.x: UNTOC came into force on 29 September 2003, not 2005; it was adopted on 15 November 2000 and has three protocols.

cn72122fcbfd73.s: The UN Convention against Corruption (UNCAC) came into force in:
cn72122fcbfd73.x: UNCAC was adopted in 2003 and came into force in 2005.

cn97138e7128aa.s: The World Health Summit, launched in 2009, is held annually in:
cn97138e7128aa.x: The World Health Summit was launched in 2009 and is held every year in Berlin, Germany.

cneb7ee27222cd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about KAUMARACON-2026 and Ayurveda?
o: Kaumarabhritya is the Ayurvedic branch of paediatrics
The Ministry of AYUSH was formed on 9 November 2017
Kaumarabhritya is one of the eight branches of Ayurveda
KAUMARACON-2026 was part of the 10th Foundation Day of AIIA
cneb7ee27222cd.x: The Ministry of AYUSH was formed on 9 November 2014, not 2017; 2017 is when AIIA was set up.

cnaf21b93e8082.s: The 7th Agrivoltaics World Conference-2026 aims to turn farmers from 'Annadatas' into:
cnaf21b93e8082.x: AWC-2026, organised by MNRE with Germany's BMUV, aims to make farmers 'Urjadatas' (energy providers) as well as 'Annadatas'.

cnaef2298d8545.s: The headquarters of OIML (International Organisation of Legal Metrology) is in:
cnaef2298d8545.x: OIML, set up in 1955, is headquartered in Paris, not Geneva; CIML is its principal decision-making committee.

cn5b9933fa1bb9.s: The BRICS Parliamentary Forum was launched in:
cn5b9933fa1bb9.x: The BRICS Parliamentary Forum began in 2015; the first BRIC summit was at Yekaterinburg in 2009.

cn7e6681134d44.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government, Dushanbe?
o: It adopted the PMTEC Action Plan 2026-2030
India was represented by Prime Minister Narendra Modi
India announced it will host the first SCO Civilizational Dialogue Forum by end-2026
cn7e6681134d44.x: India was represented by Rajnath Singh, not the Prime Minister; the meeting adopted the SCO Budget 2027 and the PMTEC Action Plan.

cn9193f928bd22.s: The Indo-Pacific Regional Dialogue (IPRD) was launched in:
cn9193f928bd22.x: IPRD was launched in 2018; its partner, the National Maritime Foundation, was set up in 2005.

cn71b686410bdb.s: India Chem-2026 was held under which Department of the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers?
o: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
cn71b686410bdb.x: India Chem-2026 was held under the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals, with India-Japan, India-US and India-EU forums.

cn0dc43153a4ea.s: The first ADMM-Plus meeting was held in 2010 in:
cn0dc43153a4ea.x: The first ADMM-Plus was held in Hanoi in 2010; ADMM-Plus has 8 Dialogue Partners.

cn290e288d4b3f.s: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) was founded on:
cn290e288d4b3f.x: ICAR was founded on 16 July 1929 and works under DARE.

cn3a46159eab89.s: What was the theme of Bharat RE 2026?
o: Unlocking Innovation. Securing Energy. Shaping Tomorrow.
cn3a46159eab89.x: Bharat RE 2026 had the theme 'Invest. Innovate. Inspire.' and was held with the 9th ISA Assembly and the 4th ICGH.

cn771775aca87d.s: Maize (Zea mays) belongs to the family:
cn771775aca87d.x: Maize (Zea mays) is a member of the grass family Poaceae.

ca8cbaeaa5722a.s: The 2026 meeting of Heads of BRICS Anti-Drug Agencies was held in:
ca8cbaeaa5722a.x: The Heads of BRICS Anti-Drug Agencies met in Guwahati; the Women Ministers met in Kochi.

ca70f7023be8d8.s: The 52nd G7 Summit Outreach Session (June 2026) was held at:
ca70f7023be8d8.x: The 52nd G7 Summit was held at Évian-les-Bains, France, not Paris, at the invitation of President Macron.

ca932845bbf399.s: In the G7, the European Union participates as a:
ca932845bbf399.x: The G7 is informal, with no treaty and no permanent secretariat; the EU participates as a non-enumerated member.

ca4982384ef364.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's proposals at the 52nd G7 Summit Outreach Session?
o: IMPACT stands for International Mobilisation Partnership for Accelerating Connectivity and Trade
India proposed a Global Skills Partnership
IMPACT envisages G7 capital, India's talent and Global South ownership
IMPACT envisages India's capital, G7 talent and Global North ownership
ca4982384ef364.x: IMPACT pairs G7 capital with India's talent under Global South ownership, not the reverse.

caa666ff1313d2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about President Murmu's visit to Romania (23 July 2026)?
o: Three agreements were signed in Science and Technology, Sports, and Indian Studies
2026 was designated the India–Romania Year of Innovation
An ICCR Indian Studies Chair was set up at the University of Bucharest
ITEC slots were doubled with AI and cyber diplomacy courses
caa666ff1313d2.x: It was 2028, not 2026, that was named the India–Romania Year of Innovation.

ca824a4bf32e99.s: The Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) was established in:
ca824a4bf32e99.x: ICCR was set up in 1950; 1964 is when the ITEC programme of the MEA began.

ca272475855706.s: Who is the Special Guest at the 18th BRICS Summit hosted by India in 2026?
ca272475855706.x: Bangladesh PM Tariq Rahman is the Special Guest under Neighbourhood First; BRICS has 11 members.

new.s: The Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities is provided for under:
new.x: The Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities is a constitutional office under Art. 350B; linguistic minorities are not under the NCM.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a statutory body?
new.x: The NCST is a constitutional body (Art. 338A); NHRC, NCW and NCM are statutory.

new.s: The 23rd Law Commission of India is chaired by:
new.x: Justice Dinesh Maheshwari (former SC judge) heads the 23rd Law Commission, constituted in September 2024, with term to 31 August 2027.

new.s: Which Law Commission report led to the Gram Nyayalayas Act, 2008?
new.x: The 114th Report (1986) on Gram Nyayalayas was accepted and led to the Gram Nyayalayas Act, 2008.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Law Commission reports:
1. The 59th Report was accepted and led to the Family Courts Act, 1984.
2. The 255th Report on EVM totalisers has been enacted into law.
3. The 214th Report reviewed the procedure for appointing judges.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The 255th Report on totalisers is still pending; the Supreme Court sought the Centre's view in 2026.

new.s: The High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections was chaired by:
new.x: The Kovind Committee, set up on 2 September 2023, reported on simultaneous elections on 14 March 2024.

new.s: The Kovind Committee proposed which new Article to synchronise the terms of the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies?
new.x: It proposed Article 82A for synchronised terms; Article 324A was for municipal and panchayat polls.

new.s: The inflation target recommended by the Urjit Patel Committee (2014) is:
new.x: The Urjit Patel Committee recommended inflation targeting at 4% ± 2%, given effect by the 2016 RBI Act amendment.

new.s: Which of the following committee – subject pairs is correctly matched?
o: Dinesh Goswami – State funding of elections
new.x: Shanta Kumar dealt with FCI–PDS reform; Nachiket Mor = financial inclusion, Dalwai = doubling farmers' income, Goswami = electoral reforms.

new.s: The K. Radhakrishnan Committee is associated with:
o: Reform of the National Testing Agency
A task force for technology-driven exams
new.x: Radhakrishnan = NTA reform; Nilekani = exam-tech task force; R. Subhash Reddy = police action in protests; Pankaj Kumar Singh = Gorkha issue.

new.s: The SEBI High-Level Committee on conflict of interest was chaired by:
new.x: Pratyush Sinha chaired SEBI's committee on conflict of interest; its framework was approved in March 2026.

new.s: How many members does the RBI Q-SAFE Committee on quantum-safe financial infrastructure have?
new.x: The RBI Q-SAFE Committee, chaired by Prof. Anil Prabhakar (IIT Madras), has 8 members.

new.s: The 16th Finance Commission kept the States' share of the divisible pool at:
new.x: The 16th FC kept vertical devolution at 41% though States had sought 50%; it was accepted in the Union Budget 2026.

new.s: Which new criterion did the 16th Finance Commission add to the horizontal devolution formula?
new.x: Contribution to GDP (10%) is new; tax and fiscal effort was dropped, while demographic performance and forest already existed.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 16th Finance Commission:
1. It is chaired by Arvind Panagariya.
2. Its award period is 2026-27 to 2030-31.
3. It raised the weight of income distance to 50%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The weight of income distance was cut from 45% to 42.5%, not raised to 50%.

new.s: The 8th Central Pay Commission is chaired by:
new.x: Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai chairs the 8th CPC; Pulak Ghosh is part-time member and Pankaj Jain member-secretary.

new.s: The 8th Central Pay Commission is to submit its report within how many months of its constitution?
new.x: The 8th CPC (terms of reference approved 28 October 2025) is to report within 18 months.

new.s: The NCHER proposal, which was never enacted, was announced by HRD Minister:
new.x: NCHER followed the Yashpal Committee (2009) and was announced by Kapil Sibal, but was never enacted.

new.s: The 393rd Report 'From Manuscript to Mission' was presented by the Parliamentary Standing Committee on:
new.x: The Standing Committee on Transport, Tourism and Culture gave the 393rd Report on manuscripts and AI (Aug 2026).

new.s: The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 on simultaneous elections was referred to:
o: A Select Committee of the Rajya Sabha
new.x: Introduced in the Lok Sabha in December 2024, the 129th Amendment Bill was sent to a JPC.

new.s: Who became chairperson of the National Commission for Scheduled Castes in 2026?
new.x: Kishor Makwana heads the NCSC; K.S. Jawahar heads the AP State SC Commission and Amit Garg the NCRB.

new.s: Vijaya Rahatkar is the chairperson of which body?
new.x: Vijaya Rahatkar has been the 9th chairperson of the NCW since 19 October 2024.

new.s: According to Crime in India 2024, which State had the highest violent-crime rate?
new.x: Odisha had the highest violent-crime rate; Telangana had the most human-trafficking cases.

new.s: According to ADSI 2024, about 31% of suicides were of:
new.x: ADSI 2024 recorded about 1.7 lakh suicides, 31% of them daily-wage workers.

new.s: Prison Statistics India is published by:
new.x: Prison Statistics India, like Crime in India and ADSI, is published by the NCRB under the MHA.

new.s: The National Family Health Survey (NFHS) is conducted by MoHFW with which nodal institution?
new.x: NFHS is run by MoHFW with the International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS), Mumbai, as nodal institution.

new.s: Which State ranked first among large States in the Export Preparedness Index 2024?
new.x: Maharashtra topped EPI 2024 (NITI Aayog), followed by TN, Gujarat, UP; Andhra Pradesh was 5th.

new.s: Which major State ranked last in NITI Aayog's Fiscal Health Index 2026?
new.x: In FHI 2026 Odisha was first and Punjab last among major States; Andhra Pradesh was 17th.

new.s: Which country holds the G20 Presidency in 2026?
new.x: The USA holds the G20 Presidency in 2026; France hosts the G7 and China APEC.

new.s: Which country hosts APEC in 2026?
new.x: China hosts APEC in 2026; the Philippines chairs ASEAN and Kyrgyzstan the SCO.

new.s: Which country hosts both the NATO summit and the COP in 2026?
new.x: Türkiye hosts the NATO summit and the COP in 2026.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (2026 meeting – venue) is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: The 25th SCO Heads of Government meeting was in Dushanbe; Bishkek hosted the 26th Heads of State summit.

new.s: Which country joined BRICS as a member in January 2025?
new.x: Indonesia joined in January 2025; Vietnam, Malaysia and Nigeria are BRICS partner countries.

new.s: Which country became the 10th BRICS partner country in 2025?
new.x: Vietnam became the 10th BRICS partner in 2025; Indonesia is a full member.

new.s: The New Delhi Declaration (2026) was the first BRICS declaration since 2022 with no reference to:
new.x: It omitted Ukraine; it did include a Pahalgam paragraph, UNSC reform and rejection of CBAM.

new.s: South Africa joined BRIC at the 3rd summit held in 2011 at:
new.x: Invited in 2010, South Africa joined at the 3rd summit at Sanya, China, in 2011.

new.s: Which institution will coordinate BRICS mental-health centres under India's 2026 Chairship?
new.x: NIMHANS is to coordinate BRICS mental-health centres; IIT Delhi hosts the Network on Digital Agriculture.

new.s: The 17th BRICS Summit at Rio de Janeiro (2025) welcomed India's candidacy to host:
new.x: The Rio summit, chaired by Lula da Silva, welcomed India's COP33 candidacy.

new.s: Which country became the 10th member of the SCO in July 2024?
new.x: Belarus became the 10th member in July 2024; Iran joined in 2023 and Mongolia is an observer.

new.s: The SCO's Regional Anti-Terrorist Structure (RATS) is located in:
new.x: RATS is in Tashkent; the SCO Secretariat is in Beijing.

new.s: Which city was named SCO Tourism and Cultural Capital 2026-27?
new.x: The Bishkek summit named Lahore the SCO Tourism and Cultural Capital 2026-27.

new.s: India's proposal to add which official language of the SCO was accepted at Bishkek?
new.x: India's proposal of English as an official language was accepted; the SCO's languages were Russian and Chinese.

new.s: The 25th SCO Heads of State summit (2025) was held in:
new.x: SCO summits: 2024 Astana, 2025 Tianjin, 2026 Bishkek.

new.s: The BIMSTEC Secretariat is located in:
new.x: BIMSTEC (Bangkok Declaration, 1997) has its headquarters in Dhaka.

new.s: What was the theme of the 6th BIMSTEC Summit held in Bangkok in April 2025?
o: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
new.x: The 6th BIMSTEC Summit (Thailand chair) had the theme 'Prosperous, Resilient and Open'.

new.s: The International Big Cat Alliance was launched in April 2023 to mark the 50th anniversary of:
new.x: IBCA was launched in April 2023 on 50 years of Project Tiger (1 April 1973); it covers 7 big cats.

new.s: The Kathmandu Declaration adopted at SAWEN's first General Assembly deals with:
new.x: SAWEN adopted the Kathmandu Declaration on wildlife crime at its first General Assembly.

new.s: With Timor-Leste joining in 2025, how many members does ASEAN now have?
new.x: ASEAN has 11 members after Timor-Leste joined in 2025.

new.s: Who led the Indian delegation at the 153rd IPU Assembly in Arusha (October 2026)?
new.x: Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh led India at the 153rd IPU Assembly.

new.s: At the G20 Innovation Ministers' Meeting in Miami, India joined a US-led initiative on:
new.x: India joined a US-led 6G initiative with 24 other countries; Bharat 6G Vision targets 2030.

new.s: IMEC was announced in September 2023 at the:
new.x: IMEC was announced at the G20 New Delhi summit during India's 2023 presidency.

new.s: The African Union became a permanent member of the G20 in:
new.x: The African Union became a permanent G20 member in 2023, under India's presidency; the G20 dates from 1999.

new.s: The Permanent Court of Arbitration (est. 1899) is located at:
new.x: The PCA sits in the Peace Palace, The Hague, and is distinct from the ICJ.

new.s: The OneSCD Global Partnership launched at the 81st UNGA concerns:
new.x: OneSCD is a global partnership on sickle cell disease, launched at the 81st UNGA in New York.

new.s: Which country hosted the launch of OneSCD at the 81st UNGA, with India as co-host?
new.x: Nigeria hosted the OneSCD launch with India as co-host; co-conveners included UNICEF and WHO.

new.s: The International Solar Alliance was launched at COP21 (2015) by India and:
new.x: ISA was launched by India and France at COP21 in 2015; its HQ is in Gurugram.

new.s: COP31 is to be held at:
new.x: COP31 is at Antalya, Türkiye; COP30 was at Belém, Brazil, and Bonn hosts the UNFCCC HQ.

new.s: Which country chairs ASEAN in 2026?
new.x: The Philippines chairs ASEAN in 2026; Kyrgyzstan chairs the SCO.

new.s: The 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi was held on:
new.x: The 18th BRICS Summit was held at Bharat Mandapam on 12-13 September 2026, not 17-19 September.

new.s: The New Development Bank, headquartered in Shanghai, was established in:
new.x: The NDB was established in 2015, not 2009 (the year of the first BRICS summit).

new.s: What was the outcome of the 16th BRICS NSA meeting chaired by Ajit Doval in June 2026?
o: A BRICS counter-terrorism convention was signed
Bangladesh was admitted as a BRICS member
The NSAs could not agree a joint statement on terrorism
A BRICS joint military exercise was announced
new.x: At the 16th BRICS NSA meeting in New Delhi the NSAs could not agree a joint statement on terrorism.

new.s: The first in-person technical meeting of the BRICS DRR Working Group (June 2026) was held in:
new.x: The DRR Working Group met in person at Puri; the 3rd DRR Ministers' meeting was in New Delhi.

new.s: The 11th BRICS Culture Ministers' meeting (2026) adopted the:
new.x: The Culture Ministers met at Bhopal and adopted the Bhopal Declaration; Jaipur gave the Tourism Ministers' declaration.

new.s: The BRICS Heads of National Statistical Offices meeting on 'Quality Statistics as Driver of Change' was held in:
new.x: The Heads of NSOs met in Lucknow on 3-4 August 2026 (MoSPI).

new.s: The BRICS Youth and Sports Ministers' meeting (August 2026) was held in:
new.x: The Youth and Sports Ministers met in Visakhapatnam on 22-23 August 2026, chaired by Mansukh Mandaviya.

new.s: The 52nd G7 Summit marked India's invitation to the G7 for the:
new.x: India was invited for the 13th time, and for the 7th consecutive year.

new.s: The 52nd G7 Summit adopted a declaration on securing supply chains for:
new.x: The G7 adopted a Declaration on Securing Supply Chains for Critical Minerals through PGII.

new.s: During the G7 Summit (June 2026), India and the EU announced the:
new.x: India-EU FTA negotiations were concluded, with signing due by the end of 2026.

new.s: Which country hosted the AI Impact Summit in 2026?
new.x: India hosted the AI Impact Summit in 2026; France had hosted the AI Action Summit in 2025.

new.s: The International Solar Alliance was launched at:
new.x: ISA was launched at COP21 in 2015; not all UN members are its members.

new.s: ACITI is a technology and innovation partnership of India, Australia and:
new.x: ACITI = Australia-Canada-India Technology and Innovation Partnership, launched 9 July 2026; it includes Canada, not Japan.

new.s: The India–China Special Representatives mechanism was established in:
new.x: The SR mechanism dates from 2003; its 25th meeting was in Beijing on 25 August 2026.

new.s: Which two WEOG countries were elected to the UN Security Council for 2027-28, both for the 4th time?
new.x: Portugal (134 votes) and Austria (131) won the WEOG seats; Denmark and Greece are among the outgoing members.

new.s: The Global Methane Pledge was launched at:
new.x: The Global Methane Pledge (cut 30% from 2020 levels by 2030) was launched at COP26, Glasgow, not COP28.

new.s: At the Bonn Climate Conference (SB64), developed countries were urged to triple adaptation finance to what by 2035?
new.x: The call was to triple adaptation finance from USD 40 bn to USD 120 bn by 2035.

new.s: The UN Political Declaration on HIV/AIDS (June 2026) aims to end AIDS by:
new.x: The declaration (149 for, 8 against, 14 abstained) aims to end AIDS by 2030 (SDG-3).

new.s: India joined Pax Silicon, a US-led initiative on trusted supply chains, at the:
new.x: India joined Pax Silicon at the AI Impact Summit in February 2026, then signed the Joint Declaration on AI Opportunities at the 2nd Pax Silicon Summit.

new.s: The Mombasa Declaration, signed by 15 countries at the 11th Our Ocean Conference, is against:
new.x: The Mombasa Declaration targets illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.

new.s: AUKUS plans underwater drones by 2027 for:
new.x: AUKUS (2021) announced underwater drones for subsea cable security by 2027.

new.s: Nauru (Naoero) has no official capital; its administrative centre is:
new.x: Nauru has no official capital; Yaren is only the administrative centre.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 23rd Law Commission of India:
1. It was constituted in September 2024 for a term of 3 years.
2. It submits its reports to the President of India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. The Law Commission reports to the Ministry of Law and Justice, not the President.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (body – latest chairperson) is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: AP State SC Commission – K.S. Jawahar
new.x: Kishor Makwana heads the NCSC; the NCW is headed by Vijaya Rahatkar.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Testing Agency (NTA):
1. It is a society registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860.
2. After the 2026 NEET leak, a Supreme Court petition sought statutory status for it.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
